objective: Implement category filtering on the demo shop without redesigning the page.
findings: The shop is a static catalog with five products and three categories.
There is no existing design system beyond demo/styles.css.
decisions: Empty state text: No products in this category.
constraints: Do not add new CSS libraries.
Keep the current type and color.
expected_deliverable: Working filter control, empty state, and testable filter helper.
acceptance_criteria: Empty state appears when there are zero matches.
